niche.habitat: Sheltered valleys between Qu-engineered pyramids and glass-melt plains; prefers fortified ruins and wind-tunnel corridors.
niche.diet: Omnivorous hunter-scout; targets domesticated livestock herds, chemosynthetic filter-mats, and metal-rich subterranean tubers.
niche.active: Crepuscular; hunts during amber twilight when dense air carries sound furthest and flare-UV peaks subside.

body: Rotated digits and gracile grasping hands evolved to manipulate complex tools and scale ancient Qu ruins without fracturing under 1.22g gravity. Enlarged saber teeth shifted from functional weapons to copper-infused, iridescent display traits, while their pack hunts rely on infrasonic drumming that travels for miles through silicate-laden fog and wind-tunneling architecture.

chains.trait: Rotated digits and gracile grasping hands
links: Rotated three-finger graspers and reduced thumb-claws evolved for sustained leverage and fine manipulation.
1.22 g gravity penalizes brute-force brawling, favoring energy-efficient mechanical advantage over raw torque.
Dense 1.8 bar atmosphere increases aerodynamic drag, selecting for streamlined, low-mass limb architecture.
Ruined fortress terrain demands multi-axis digit manipulation for climbing, weapon handling, and tool cranking.

skill.effect: Its twisted fingers grip tools and weapons with practiced ease, allowing it to swap between them swiftly and strike with heavy leverage. You can watch it maneuver through tight spaces with fluid, precise movements.

chains.weakness: Disarmed, grip torque drops sharply on improvised tools; specialized thenar muscles lack raw crushing force.
observe: Thumb is a padded callus, not a weapon.
Fingers rotate 90° to crank rifle bolts or herding leashes.
Bow limbs held under sustained tension without fatigue.

journal.en: They traded muscle for leverage, turning the ghost of the claw into a handle.

plausibility.summary: Treat ‘rotation’ as wrist/forearm pronation–supination and repositioned grasping digits (predator→tool-user), not literal 90° finger torsion; tie gracilization to F3 (leverage over torque at 1.22 g) and fortress/tool ecology (F8), and drop atmosphere drag (F5) as a primary hand-shape selector—use it only for sprinting/body profile.
fixes: Treat ‘rotation’ as wrist/forearm pronation–supination and repositioned grasping digits (predator→tool-user), not literal 90° finger torsion; tie gracilization to F3 (leverage over torque at 1.22 g) and fortress/tool ecology (F8), and drop atmosphere drag (F5) as a primary hand-shape selector—use it only for sprinting/body profile.

analogues.organism: Hominin canine reduction and precision grip with sustained tool use; primate thenar/opposition versus ursid crushing grip (trade precision for force).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Ceremonial hunts guided by infrasonic drumming
links: Infrasonic drumming and tremor-sensing evolved to coordinate hunts and navigate fog-shrouded ruins.
High acoustic impedance channels low-frequency pulses through stone wind tunnels and pyramid bases.
Dense, aerosol-laden atmosphere scatters visible light and high-frequency vocalizations, blinding optical targeting.
High UV/X-ray flare flux restricts safe surface activity to twilight windows, forcing acoustic reliance.

skill.effect: It presses its ears to the earth to feel distant footsteps, silently calculating where you will step before springing from the shadows. In crumbling ruins, it moves with an unsettling awareness, always knowing your exact position.

chains.weakness: Reliant on low-frequency communication; high-pitched acoustic jammers or sudden structural collapses disrupt targeting and cause disorientation.
observe: Broad nasal cavity for acoustic resonance.
Reinforced mastoid bones transmit ground vibration directly to the inner ear.
Ceremonial drumming kits etched with herd migrations and wind-tunnel acoustics.

journal.en: The sky burns, the stone hums, and the hunt begins where light fails and sound leads.

plausibility.summary: Keep drums and pyramid wind-tunnels as cultural/terrain amplifiers (F8, F16); ground-coupled sensing via enlarged pedal fat pads and bone conduction (mastoid/sacrum), because human cochlear hearing is weak below ~20 Hz—passive ‘Tremor Sight’ should be somatosensory + learned cueing, not pure infrasonic audition.
fixes: Keep drums and pyramid wind-tunnels as cultural/terrain amplifiers (F8, F16); ground-coupled sensing via enlarged pedal fat pads and bone conduction (mastoid/sacrum), because human cochlear hearing is weak below ~20 Hz—passive ‘Tremor Sight’ should be somatosensory + learned cueing, not pure infrasonic audition.

analogues.organism: African elephant (Loxodonta africana) low-frequency rumbles and seismic reception through feet and bone conduction.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Enlarged saber teeth maintained as ritual display
links: Enamel thickened and crown height increased to catch amber twilight and project status without metabolic cost.
High-density atmosphere scatters high-frequency screams, making visual cues more reliable for long-range parley.
Hunter nobilities codified the hunt into religion, shifting selection from utility to status signaling.
Tool-use rendered functional fangs a liability in close-quarters biting contests, preserving only ornamental dentition.

skill.effect: It bares its massive fangs in a silent, ritualistic display that strikes fear into nearby foes, causing them to pause and falter in their attacks. Its companions draw strength from the display, standing taller and fighting with renewed courage.

chains.weakness: Teeth are brittle; a direct bite against hard armor or stone shatters them, leaving the individual vulnerable.
observe: Dentition shows zero wear from food, only polishing from ritual stones.
Rivals stare at the mouth during parley, measuring the enamel gleam.
Teeth vibrate with low-hum to catch fog-mists and amplify shimmer.

journal.en: They traded muscle for mind, but the ghost of the claw sleeps in the wrist. Wait for the bare hand.

plausibility.summary: Model canines as honest-but-costly ornaments under sexual/social selection (polishing, gnashing rituals, not mastication); allow slight wear from soft foods; remove ‘teeth vibrate with low-hum to shimmer’ (highly speculative) and rely on F6 amber twilight glint on enamel; brittle-display weakness stays if enamel is oversized and unused in bite-kills.
fixes: Model canines as honest-but-costly ornaments under sexual/social selection (polishing, gnashing rituals, not mastication); allow slight wear from soft foods; remove ‘teeth vibrate with low-hum to shimmer’ (highly speculative) and rely on F6 amber twilight glint on enamel; brittle-display weakness stays if enamel is oversized and unused in bite-kills.

analogues.organism: Musk deer (Moschus) tusk-like canines used mainly in display/fight rituals; Irish elk (Megaloceros) runaway ornament selection.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

temperament: Ritualistic and fiercely hierarchical, they treat yearly hunting duels as sacred civic duties rather than mere sustenance.
secrets: TRAIT: Rotated digits & gracile hands <- why: 1.22g gravity demands energy-efficient locomotion and fracture resistance <- why: Qu ruins require climbing, lever-opening, and precision tool use <- PHYSICAL ROOT: 1.22g gravity + preserved architecture -> SKILL: Precision Grip (Control/Defence) stabilizes weapons, Weakness: heavy blunt force strains joints.

TRAIT: Infrasonic drumming <- why: 1.8 bar atmosphere and silicate aerosols scatter high frequencies but transmit infrasound efficiently <- why: coordinated hunting of large herds requires silent, long-range pack communication <- PHYSICAL ROOT: 1.8 bar atmosphere + acoustic waveguides -> SKILL: Resonance Call (Engage) coordinates pack and dampens prey panic, Weakness: sudden high-pitched flares cause disorientation.

TRAIT: Enlarged saber teeth <- why: tool-mediated hunting reduced predation pressure, shifting selection to sexual display <- why: copper bioavailability allows trace-metal enamel that shines in amber twilight <- PHYSICAL ROOT: copper-rich environment + cultural ritualization -> SKILL: Intimidate (Engage) triggers submission, Weakness: metabolically costly to maintain, requires high calcium/copper intake.
moments: Watch them synchronize a pack hunt by drumming on hollowed glass pillars, sending pressure waves through the fog to herd livestock into kill zones.
Observe a young hunter displaying their iridescent sabers to win a mating right, ignoring the actual prey until the ritual concludes.
